Name: (CP) Cats as Farm Animals
Author: suushiico
Description:
[center][size=6][b][/b][/size]This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods, including re-use of any assets and code. I still ask that you do not repost to other websites! Please feel free to go in and fix the bugs, add more content, change it completely, etc.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/POX3j70.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/y8ljgxe.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Qkma52v.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/XNlDYsJ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/1o2l6Y8.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/5wkAG9L.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Z8Fl82O.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿
Adds cats as a livestock option. Cats drop seasonal fish daily![/center][b][size=6]Installation
[/size][/b]
You must already have the most up-to-date versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order to run this mod.
You must be running SDV version 1.6+.

Download the .zip file under [i]Files[/i] and extract the contents to your Mods folder.


[size=6][b]FAQ
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Where can I purchase cats as livestock?
[/b][/size]Like other livestock, you can purchase them from Marnie's Ranch!

[size=4][b]What breeds are included?
[/b][/size]All 5 forms of the vanilla cat breeds are included, plus the secret Iridium cat which is unused in the vanilla, and a custom black and white Chimera cat breed.

[size=4][b]What fish are dropped?
[/b][/size]All common fish (non legendaries) are dropped at random! Deluxe drops include fish that are generally worth more (such as Catfish). You may adjust the config so that cats drop only seasonal fish, or all fish regardless of season.

[size=4][b]Is this mod configurable?
[/b][/size][size=2]Yes! You can configure the mod (I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]). As of [i]version 2.0.0[/i], you can enable/disable Random Color Purchase. When enabled, purchased Cats will be a random color out of the 7 available cats. When disabled, each enabled color will be an individual animal listing in Marnie's Ranch.

[i]Warning: if changing Random Color Purchase in the middle of a save, it is advised to sell your Cats and then update your config before reloading your save. Otherwise, error sprites may be applied to your Cats.[/i]

[/size][size=4][b]What mods are you using in the screenshots?[/b][/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21220]﻿Legacy Coops and Barns[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=4][b]Any other recommended mods?
[/b][/size]Yes! I also created [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23905](CP) Junimos as Farm Animals[/url] which adds Junimos as a livestock option (Junimos drop seasonal crops daily), and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22993](CP) Dogs as Farm Animals[/url] which adds dogs as a livestock option (dogs dig up bone fragments and artifacts).

Downloads.Description:
Adds option in config to enable/disable random color purchasing of Cats from Marnie's Ranch. You may now explicitly choose which breed to purchase if disabled.

Added custom Chimera cat breed.
